title: Project overview
description: Read the reconstruction scope, placeholders and disconnected integrations. HTML is pre-rendered; the Node server is a local preview tool.

title: Shared content model
description: All routes derive shared business metadata, services and media from this module. Empty booking/form settings intentionally preserve the disconnected state.

title: Templates and document shell
description: Read escaped primitives and shared header/footer before route assembly. The shell consistently attaches styles, app.js and landmarks.

title: Route rendering
description: Follow getPages, homepage rendering and secondary-layout selection. The final HTML uses referenceBody overrides rather than only the initial fallback bodies.

title: Browser interaction
description: The browser script owns disclosure behavior, calculator validation and inquiry preparation. The default form creates a mailto link and sends nothing.

title: Static build and server
description: The build writes directory-index routes and 404.html. The loopback preview imports the build and handles occupied ports without killing other processes.

title: Checks and remaining work
description: Static route/media checks and browser scripts provide different evidence. Original approved media, legal text and enabled integrations remain outside this analysis.
